title: Clinical AI Agents, MCP Tooling, and Vector Search with dicomtk.ai
text: dicomtk.ai extends dicomtk ellmer-based clinical imaging agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server via mcptools, pluggable AI segmentation backends uncertainty maps, clinical report NLP, RadLex / LOINC-RSNA protocol harmonisation, DuckDB vector similarity search.

title: Clinical AI Agents, MCP Tooling, and Vector Search with dicomtk.ai
text: Every de-identification workflow enforces PS3.15 monotonic join-semilattice (K < C < U < D < Z < X), preventing LLM caller weakening baseline profile:
code: library(dicomtk) library(dicomtk.ai)  synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 4L), phi_profile = "basic") out_dir <- tempfile("ai_vignette_out_")  plan <- ai_agent_plan(   task = "deid_and_qc",   path = synth[["out_dir"]],   baseline_profile = dicom_deid_profile("ps3.15"),   chat = ai_chat("offline") ) dry <- ai_agent_dry_run(plan) approved <- ai_agent_approve(dry, auto_approve = TRUE, approver = "vignette") exec_res <- ai_agent_execute(approved, out_dir = out_dir) ver <- ai_agent_verify(exec_res) ver$passed #> [1] TRUE

text: IBSI Phase-1 Radiomics (R/radiomics-ibsi.R): Added ibsi_digital_phantom() ai_extract_radiomics() computing morphology, first-order intensity, 3D GLCM, 3D GLRLM, 3D GLSZM features. Train/Test-Safe ComBat Harmonisation (R/combat.R): Added combat_fit(), combat_apply(), ai_combat_harmonize() Empirical Bayes scanner batch harmonisation without test-set leakage. MONAI MAISI Synthetic Data (R/maisi-synthetic.R): Added ai_generate_maisi() 3D synthetic CT DICOM series + multi-organ label masks DERIVED\\SECONDARY\\SYNTHETIC provenance tagging.

title: dicomtk.ai 0.1.0
text: ellmer-based chat wrapper (ai_chat(), as_ellmer_chat()) 5-stage clinical agent loop (ai_agent_plan(), ai_agent_dry_run(), ai_agent_approve(), ai_agent_execute(), ai_agent_verify()) unbypassable monotonic de-identification guardrails. Native Model Context Protocol server (dicomtk_mcp_tools(), start_mcp_server()) powered mcptools. Pluggable AI backend registry (register_ai_backend(), list_ai_backends()) segmentation + voxel-wise uncertainty estimation (ai_segment()) IHE AIR-aligned DICOM SEG + TID 1500 export (ai_export_results()). Clinical report de-identification (ai_deid_report()), weak-label extraction (ai_extract_labels()), RadLex / LOINC-RSNA protocol harmonisation (ai_harmonize_protocol(), radlex_playbook). Foundation study embeddings DuckDB similar-case retrieval (ai_embed(), ai_embedding_index(), ai_index_add(), ai_search_similar()).
